device.model: TPZ001 piezo driver with TSG001 strain gauge reader
device.name: Thorlabs TPZ001 piezo controller (piezo.PiezoController)

facts.text: The repository contains code for the control of the Thorlabs TPZ001 piezo driver and TSG001 strain gauge reader with the Kinesis API
The module imports pythonnet's clr and the Thorlabs Kinesis .NET assemblies
The README lists pythonnet as a requirement
The Kinesis DLLs the module references must be placed in libs/kinesis
PiezoController takes the controller serial number and an optional strain gauge reader serial number
initialize creates a StrainReader from the reader serial number when one is configured
initialize sets the output voltage range maximum to 75 and both the voltage and percentage jog step sizes to 1 before loading the settings into the device
connect_enable connects the device, waits for the settings, starts 250 ms polling, sleeps 500 ms and enables the device
get_units returns '%' in closed loop and 'V' in open loop
get_value returns the percentage travel in closed loop and the output voltage in open loop
set_value writes the percentage travel in closed loop and the output voltage in open loop
moveup and movedown call Jog(1) and Jog(2)
move_to_home writes 0 percentage travel in closed loop and 0 output voltage in open loop
is_closed_loop returns the device status flag IsClosedLoop
set_closed_loop selects the software voltage source and position control mode 2
set_open_loop selects the software voltage source and position control mode 1
calibrate_pos drives 10 and 70 percent of travel, reads the strain gauge position at each point, and fits percentage = a*position + b
move_to_pos converts a reader position to percentage travel with the calibration slope and offset
move_pos_up moves 1 reader unit up while the reading is below 19 and move_pos_down moves 1 unit down while it is above 1
move_pos_to_home calls move_to_pos(0)
The reader position is the strain gauge status reading converted from a .NET Decimal to double
set_zero calls SetZero and is_zeroing returns the status flag IsZeroing
The reader get_units maps display mode 1 to micrometre, 2 to volt, 3 to newton and anything else to an error string

operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states the permitted travel range in percentage or the permitted output voltage of an installed stage; the 75 V maximum the upstream sets is an output-range setting (piezo.py:219), not a safe travel bound, so the site supplies the bound in the unit of the mode in use

operator_required.name: move_to_position
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states the travel range of the installed stage; the two convenience steps guard only at 19 and 1 reader units (piezo.py:332,336), not a travel bound, so the site supplies the permitted position range in the reader display unit

safe_state.description: piezo travel driven to zero (percentage travel 0 or output voltage 0 V)
